title: Circles
subtitle: Study circles held at centres, and who supervises each one
location_hint: A circle carries no address of its own — its location is its centre's, so correcting the centre applies here automatically.
center_immutable_hint: A circle cannot move to another centre. Its location is its centre's, so moving it would retroactively relocate everything that reads through it.
supervisor_hint: A supervisor is a user account of type admin. Until Epic 14 this appointment grants no permission over contestants.
centers_truncated: Showing the first 100 centres only. If the one you need is missing, use the Centres screen.
admins_truncated: Showing the first 100 administrators only. If the person you need is missing, use the Users screen.
delete_message: “{{name}}” will be closed. It is not destroyed, and applications that froze its name keep it. A circle with contestants still enrolled cannot be closed.
error_name_long: The circle name is too long (255 characters maximum).
